input.question: Where is Chesapeake High School located?

documents.text: Chesapeake High School (Baltimore County) Chesapeake High School (CHS), is a four-year public high school in Baltimore County, Maryland, United States. Chesapeake High School is one of two high schools in Maryland by that name, the other being Chesapeake High School, Anne Arundel County. The Chesapeake High School of Baltimore County is located in southeast corner of the county in Essex, Maryland. The school borders the school districts of Kenwood High School, Sparrows Point High School, Dundalk High School, and Patapsco High School. Widely known for its Virtual Lab and MCJROTC program.
